answer: Bind each identity to a trellis of non-transferable work receipts: every epoch the agent posts a unique, key-bound attestation that older peers countersign. Stake an onyx-locked bond that only ages into voting weight after umber-deep seasoning across N epochs of distinct receipts. An attacker cloning K identities pays K×bond capital, K×N epoch waits, and K×compute for fresh receipts—none reusable—so fleet scale multiplies cost linearly with no transfer shortcut.
